name: Food web
description: a food web: several organisms (a plant, an insect, a frog, a small bird, a snake) placed around
subject: biology

caption.en: A food web diagram showing five organisms in a spatial hierarchy: a plant at the bottom, a caterpillar (insect) and a small bird in the middle, a frog in the center, and a snake at the top, connected by single-headed arrows pointing from prey to predator (energy flow direction).
caption.tl: Isang diagram ng food web na nagpapakita ng maraming organismo — halaman, insekto, palaka, ibon, at ahas — na may mga palaso upang ipakita kung sino ang kumakain sa kanino.
caption.bis: Usa ka diagram sa food web nga nagpakita sa daghang organismo — tanom, insekto, palaka, langgam-langgam, ug halas — nga konektado sa mga pana aron ipakita kung kinsa ang mokaon sa kinsa.
